name: l3-valour-up
hypothesis: Lift the Raids group: Valour 2/3/4/5 -> 3/4/5/6 per held Raid. Raids is 14-18% of all Renown but the winner's top group in < 15%; one more Valour per held Season moves some winners from Town to Raids, and Victors' Oak (scoreBeat valour) is untouched. Level 2 holds 47-72% of Raids, level 1 25-60%, so level 2 should gain more.
